verdict.rationale: Algolia's Agent Studio is an agent-building platform, so letting it consume external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows that Agent Studio or any other Algolia surface can register external MCP servers as tool sources. The only MCP evidence is Algolia's own MCP server, which is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
